thread:
sanjay: Quick callout — need final sign-off for Copperlane Private rollout. Proposed window: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: pin tenant to runtime v2.14.1-rc3 (no auto-updates), canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with evaluation gates. KMS rotation is scheduled the next day; prefer to postpone it 48h. Rollback criteria: >3% 5xx or p90 latency >350ms sustained for 3m. Object?

deploybot: [automation] Runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/copperlane/rollout-5112345678 — contains checklist + smoke scripts. To trigger: ```deploybot trigger --tenant copperlane --version v2.14.1-rc3 --mode canary```

maria: LGTM on window. I'll ping CS to hold KMS rotation. We should also confirm quantization profile (q4_16) and KV priming step.

ops_lead: Please ensure preflight smoke against staging uses q4_16 and we commit results to /releases/copperlane/priming. Also require KV cache priming (runbook step 4) before canary. I want a standby operator on the 02:00 UTC shift.

julie: CS can shift KMS rotation to 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC. They'll be on call during rollout and have a pilot account to sanity-check. @maria can you confirm with them?

sanjay: Confirmed. Canary cadence adjusted to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m waits between promotions. Monitoring: 5xx rate, p95/p99, tokens/sec, error-rate by prompt-type. If any metric breaches, we stop and rollback.

deploybot: Approval check: approvers required: @sanjay, @maria, @ops_lead. Current approvals: sanjay, maria. Waiting on ops_lead.

ops_lead: Approved. I'll be on-call at 02:00 UTC. One constraint: set fallback model to v2.13.9-quant-lite in case of OOMs or memory regressions. Add fallback to runbook step 7.

maria: Product approves. Fallback noted. CS confirmed on-call.

sanjay: All approvals in place. Deploybot scheduled kick: 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. Reminder: DO NOT rotate KMS for Copperlane until at least 48h post-rollout.

deploybot: Stage 1 (canary 10%) started at 02:00Z. Job id: db-5112345678-01. Monitoring dashboard: https://metrics.internal/redwood/copperlane/5112345678

deploybot: Stage 1 complete (02:12Z). Health check: p95=120ms, 5xx=0.02%, tokens/sec nominal. No immediate regressions. Ready to promote to 50% pending human ack.

ops_lead: Ack. Promote.

deploybot: Stage 2 (50%) started at 02:15Z. Mid-run snapshot: p95=150ms, 5xx=0.04%. No degraded error signatures. Will await 20m stabilization window.

julie: CS reports pilot account shows normal behaviour, no anomalous outputs.

deploybot: Stage 2 complete (02:36Z). Metrics stable. Promoting to 100%.

deploybot: Stage 3 (100%) complete at 02:46Z. Final metrics: p95=160ms, p99=320ms, 5xx=0.03%. Rollout successful. Tenant copperlane pinned to v2.14.1-rc3 (pin recorded).

sanjay: Notes for record: - Rollout duration: ~46m - Canary increments: 10/50/100 - Fallback (v2.13.9-quant-lite) not used - KMS rotation rescheduled to 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC - KV priming completed as step 4 - Follow-up: update latency baseline and cost report (observed cost delta ~+8% due to quant profile). Thanks everyone :tada:

maria: Adding release note to internal tracker and notifying customer. Closing thread.
